segments.name: Digital Asset Technology
segments.description: Digital asset technology company acquiring and holding ETH as a treasury asset while operating BTC mining, hosting and advisory services.
segments.evidence: In accordance with ASC 280-10, Segment Reporting, management has determined that the Company operates as one operating segment and one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Institutional customers pay for mining equipment and energized space, hosting, management services, consulting, advisory and equipment leasing.
revenueModel.evidence: Hosting services include the provision of mining equipment and energized space, as well as monitoring, troubleshooting, repair, and maintenance of customer mining equipment.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 the Company decided to dispose of its Trinidad operation and sold all property and equipment located there.
changes.evidence: The Company previously had operation in Trinidad which is decided to dispose of during fiscal year 2025.
